content.value_statement: Email teams need personalization that still works when profile data is incomplete. This skill maps tags, conditional content, fallbacks, and PII rules before handoff.
actual_capabilities: Maps each personalization tag to a real export column and a rendered fallback.
Defines segment-based conditional content with a required default branch.
Audits worst-case renders for empty fields, missing products, and broken punctuation.
Lists which PII fields may render and which fields must stay out of body copy.
Creates a handoff summary for downstream rendering or email quality review.
limitations: It does not write the base email creative.
It does not create or refresh audience segments.
It does not score EQS or run final deliverability vetoes.
It needs column names, segment names, or fill rates from the user or export.

use_cases.title: Prepare Lifecycle Campaign Personalization
use_cases.description: Map customer fields and segment rules before a retention or win-back email is rendered.

use_cases.title: Review Merge Tag Safety
use_cases.description: Check that every personalized field has a natural fallback before an email is sent.

use_cases.title: Control Visible PII
use_cases.description: Decide which profile fields can appear in body copy and which must be replaced.

prompt_templates.title: Add Basic Fallbacks
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for simple merge tags.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add safe fallbacks to this email. The available columns are first name, city, and last product category.

prompt_templates.title: Build Segment Blocks
prompt_templates.prompt: Create conditional content rules for champions, at-risk customers, and new subscribers. Include a default branch.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Personalization Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this personalized email for empty-field renders, missing defaults, unsupported claims, and visible PII.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Render Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced handoff to the rendering or quality workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create the final personalization spec and handoff summary for the render builder. Include fallback and PII decisions.

output_examples.input: An email uses first name, city, and last product category, but fill rates are mixed.
output: A tag map that binds each field to a known column.
A natural fallback for each field when data is missing.
A worst-case render check that avoids awkward greetings and empty references.

output_examples.input: A campaign needs different offer text for loyal, inactive, and new subscribers.
output: Segment rules with named branches for each audience.
A catch-all default message for anyone outside the segment map.
A note for any offer claim that needs approved wording.

output_examples.input: A reviewer wants to know whether profile fields are safe to show in an email.
output: A list of fields allowed in visible copy.
A list of blocked sensitive fields.
Safer substitutes for fields that expose too much personal detail.

best_practices: Provide the exact export columns and fill rates before asking for final rules.
Use neutral fallbacks that read naturally when every optional field is empty.
Keep raw subscriber rows out of prompts and saved handoff summaries.
anti_patterns: Do not invent segment names or column names when the source data is missing.
Do not personalize with sensitive identifiers such as email address or order ID.
Do not ship a conditional block without a default branch.

faq.question: Does this skill write the email copy?
faq.answer: No. It adds personalization rules to existing email creative.

faq.question: Can it build audience segments?
faq.answer: No. It needs an existing segment map or column list.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the email creative, segment names, available columns, and fill rates when available.

faq.question: How does it handle missing data?
faq.answer: It assigns explicit fallbacks and checks the worst-case rendered message.

faq.question: Can it include personal data in examples?
faq.answer: It should not echo raw subscriber PII. Use column names and aggregate rules instead.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible hosts.
